title: The Long Way Across
setup: The black rook guards the back rank from all the way across the board — the only defender, far from home.
hint: The guard can reach e8, but only by leaving everything else. What is the biggest thing you can make it capture?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on b8 covers the whole back rank from a distance, until it is forced to commit.

{{Qe8+}} gives the queen away on the entry square. {{Rxe8}} is the only answer, dragging the guard across the rank, and {{Rxe8#}} recaptures with Black's own pawns sealing every flight square.

A lone back-rank defender is a target, not a wall: make it capture, and the recapture is mate.
